name: Build a 3D object headless in Blender and export a .glb
description: Run Blender in the background (-b --python) on this machine to build a 3D object from your own bpy script or one of the presets (cube, sphere, chair, table, mug), export it as a .glb (bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf, GLB) into the shared folder's files/3d, and render a 512x512 turntable still next to it. Finds Blender in the usual places (BLENDER env, /Applications, PATH, /usr/bin, /opt/blender*, ~/Downloads/blender-*, Program Files). Use it for any 3D object a request asks for; show the result with ui_open view model.

name.description: file name of the result (a-z, 0-9, - _), e.g. coffee-mug → coffee-mug.glb + coffee-mug.png

preset.description: a built-in object; ignored when script is given

script.description: your own bpy code that builds the scene (runs after the default scene is cleared; everything left in the scene is exported)

out.description: where the .glb goes; default <shared folder>/files/3d/<name>.glb (the PNG goes next to it)

render.description: also render a 512x512 turntable still (Workbench, headless-safe); default true

blender.description: path of the Blender executable when it is not in a usual place (or set BLENDER)

dryRun.description: show the resolved Blender path, output paths and the generated Python without running Blender

outputs: { ok, glb, png, node, triangles, objects, blender, version } or { ok: false, error, log }
